newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypo-Bank won't rule out capital rise this year.
newsitem.headline: Hypo-Bank won't rule out capital rise this year.

text.p: German Bayerische Hypotheken und Wechselbank AG, Hypo-Bank, management board chairman Eberhart Martini said the group had no concrete plans to raise capital in 1997 at present but would not rule out such a measure this year.

Martini told a news conference that the increase of its stake in British fund manager Foreign & Colonial last year to 65 percent from 50 percent, and a strong expansion in mortgage lending in the final months of 1996 had affected its capital adequacy.
Hypo-Bank's core capital ratio fell to 4.9 percent in 1996 and its overall capital ratio fell to 8.5 percent from 9.1 percent in 1995.
Martini said the bank planned to make an issue of profit participation certificates or warrant bonds this year to help beef up reserves.
